CONTROLS.NAME: cam_look
CONTROLS.LABEL: Cam Look
CONTROLS.DESCRIPTION: Look left or right with pitch bend and tilt up with the mod wheel.

CONTROLS.NAME: shimmer
CONTROLS.LABEL: Shimmer
CONTROLS.DESCRIPTION: Send a bright colour pulse through the membranes.

CONTROLS.NAME: shock
CONTROLS.LABEL: Shock
CONTROLS.DESCRIPTION: Send a vertical pressure wave through the fluid.

CONTROLS.NAME: reset_center
CONTROLS.LABEL: Reset Center
CONTROLS.DESCRIPTION: Feed new cells into the centre of the simulation.

CONTROLS.NAME: bpm_oscillate
CONTROLS.LABEL: BPM Oscillate
CONTROLS.DESCRIPTION: Reverse the flow in time with the beat.

CONTROLS.NAME: media_color
CONTROLS.LABEL: Media Color
CONTROLS.DESCRIPTION: Change which cell population is fed by the image or video mask.

CONTROLS.NAME: tunnel
CONTROLS.LABEL: Tunnel
CONTROLS.DESCRIPTION: Pull the feedback towards the centre independently on each axis.

CONTROLS.NAME: pyramid
CONTROLS.LABEL: Pyramid
CONTROLS.DESCRIPTION: Fold the surface into triangular reflections.

CONTROLS.NAME: mirror
CONTROLS.LABEL: Mirror
CONTROLS.DESCRIPTION: Reflect the fluid across the centre of the view.
